methods: Independent mpmath 80-digit FP64-oracle equation replay; exact FP32 high+low F, captured accepted history, FP32 H and FP32 parameter words; center/one-sided/centered dimensional perturbation sweeps with fixed max|delta F|; branch labels from exact elastic trial q; repeat at 50 vs 80 decimal digits to estimate numerical precision convergence, not empirical stochastic noise.
threshold_policy: No tolerance relaxed. FD <=1e-6 is reported only where the exact q branch is the same for minus/center/plus and tangent scale is nonzero.
